author: IGN
description:
Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie understands that video games are ridiculous, and that's why it's great.

Video games are ridiculous. The Resident Evil series is a perfect example. One moment you’re running in terror from a comically oversized, trench-coated tank of a man in a tiny hat; the next, you’re messing around with electronic chess pieces to open a door. These are completely alien situations that, somehow, these games compel us to navigate with rational thought. This is what Zach Cregger understands so well about Capcom’s genre-defining series. His Resident Evil movie knows this is ridiculous, so it lets its lead, Brian, progress through a 90-minute rollercoaster just as we would with a controller in our hands. It’s a fantastic translation of the sensation of playing a survival horror game, never forgetting to include every piece of glorious nonsense that comes with it.

#ign #residentevil
title: The Resident Evil Movie Understands Video Games Are Ridiculous, and That's Why It's Great

description:
Take a look at **24 minutes of Dune: Awakening single-player gameplay** captured on **PS5 Pro in 4K Performance Mode**. See the dangerous world of Arrakis in action as we explore, fight, gather resources, and survive the harsh desert environment.
This gameplay footage gives you a closer look at how Dune: Awakening runs on PS5 Pro, including exploration, combat, traversal, crafting, and the game's massive open-world environments. **Dune: Awakening** is an open-world survival RPG set in the Dune universe, where surviving Arrakis is just as important as uncovering its secrets.
title: Dune: Awakening PS5 Pro - 24 Minutes of Single-Player Gameplay (Captured in 4K)

author: IGN
description: Sega's side-scrolling brawler may be a storied game franchise, but it's not exactly known for its story. Golden Axe showrunners Mike McMahan and Joe Chandler and stars Matthew Rhys, Liam McIntyre, Danny Pudi, and Carl Tart join IGN's Tom Jorgensen to explain how that was the perfect place to start building the show's mythology and how they incorporate video game logic into both the comedy and action. Matthew Rhys also reveals who he thinks his friend Conan O'Brien should play in Golden Axe Season 2.
title: How Golden Axe Adapts A Video Game Mythology No One Knows

author: IGN
description:
Saving the world in The Blood of Dawnwalker is a heavy burden, but that doesn't mean you can't find a little love along the way. Whether you are drawn to the mysterious witch Anca, the fierce rebellion leader Crake, or the dark and dangerous vrakhiri Lacra, knowing exactly what to say and when to say it is crucial if you want to win their hearts.
This comprehensive gameplay guide breaks down the exact dialogue choices, quest orders, and key interactions needed to unlock every relationship. From navigating Anca's Latin studies and Crake's manumit rebellion to surviving Lacra's deadly trials in Svartrau City, we cover every necessary step. Secure your favorite companion by mastering crucial quests like The Firebrand, Distant Shadows, and The Night of Horrors without missing a single flirting opportunity.
